<script>
(()=>{
const cv=document.querySelector('#game'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d'),ncv=document.querySelector('#next'),nctx=ncv.getContext('2d');
const W=500,H=650,C=32,COLS=10,ROWS=18,BX=90,BY=37,BW=C*COLS,BH=C*ROWS;
const palette={I:'#63ded4',O:'#f4d45d',T:'#b88aff',S:'#9cdd70',Z:'#ff7f9b',J:'#76aaff',L:'#ffad68'};
const shapes={I:[[1,1,1,1]],O:[[1,1],[1,1]],T:[[0,1,0],[1,1,1]],S:[[0,1,1],[1,1,0]],Z:[[1,1,0],[0,1,1]],J:[[1,0,0],[1,1,1]],L:[[0,0,1],[1,1,1]]};
let board,piece,next,platforms,player,score,lines,level,best,fallTimer,toastTimer,last=0,active=false,paused=false,over=false,keys={},lastMove=0;
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s),overlay=$('#overlay');
best=Number(localStorage.getItem('blockbound-best')||0);$('#best').textContent=String(best).padStart(5,'0');
function randPiece(){const k=Object.keys(shapes)[Math.random()*7|0];return {k,m:shapes[k].map(r=>r.slice()),x:3,y:-1}}
function reset(){board=Array.from({length:ROWS},()=>Array(COLS).fill(null));platforms=[];score=0;lines=0;level=1;fallTimer=0;piece=randPiece();next=randPiece();player={x:BX+BW/2-10,y:BY+BH-25,vx:0,vy:0,onGround:true,face:1};active=true;paused=false;over=false;keys={};updateStats();$('#status').textContent='IN PLAY';overlay.classList.add('hidden');spawn();drawNext()}
function spawn(){piece=next;piece.x=3;piece.y=-1;next=randPiece();drawNext();if(collides(piece,piece.x,piece.y)){endGame()}}
function collides(p,x,y){for(let r=0;r<p.m.length;r++)for(let c=0;c<p.m[r].length;c++)if(p.m[r][c]){let xx=x+c,yy=y+r;if(xx<0||xx>=COLS||yy>=ROWS)return true;if(yy>=0&&board[yy][xx])return true}return false}
function lock(){for(let r=0;r<piece.m.length;r++)for(let c=0;c<piece.m[r].length;c++)if(piece.m[r][c]){let y=piece.y+r,x=piece.x+c;if(y<0){endGame();return}board[y][x]=piece.k}
let cleared=[];for(let r=ROWS-1;r>=0;r--)if(board[r].every(Boolean))cleared.push(r);
if(cleared.length){const stamps=cleared.map(r=>BY+r*C);board=board.filter(row=>!row.every(Boolean));while(board.length<ROWS)board.unshift(Array(COLS).fill(null));platforms.push(...stamps.map(y=>({y,life:8.5,max:8.5})));lines+=cleared.length;score+=[0,100,300,500,800][cleared.length]*level;level=1+Math.floor(lines/10);toast();updateStats()}
spawn()}
function updateStats(){$('#score').textContent=String(score).padStart(5,'0');$('#lines').textContent=String(lines).padStart(2,'0');$('#level').textContent=String(level).padStart(2,'0');if(score>best){best=score;localStorage.setItem('blockbound-best',best);$('#best').textContent=String(best).padStart(5,'0')}}
function toast(){const el=$('#toast');el.classList.add('show');toastTimer=1.5}
function endGame(){active=false;over=true;$('#status').textContent='RUN OVER';$('#modal-eyebrow').textContent='NICE RUN';$('#modal-title').innerHTML='The stack got you.';$('#modal-copy').textContent=`You scored ${score.toLocaleString()} and cleared ${lines} line${lines===1?'':'s'}. Ready to take another leap?`;$('#start').textContent='PLAY AGAIN  ↗';overlay.classList.remove('hidden')}
function rotate(){const m=piece.m[0].map((_,i)=>piece.m.map(row=>row[i]).reverse());for(const dx of [0,-1,1,-2,2])if(!collides({m},piece.x+dx,piece.y)){piece.m=m;piece.x+=dx;return}}
function jump(){if(active&&!paused&&player.onGround){player.vy=-485;player.onGround=false}}
function togglePause(){if(!active&&!paused)return;paused=!paused;$('#status').textContent=paused?'PAUSED':'IN PLAY';if(paused){$('#modal-eyebrow').textContent='TAKE A BREATHER';$('#modal-title').innerHTML='Paused.';$('#modal-copy').textContent='Your stack is holding. Ready when you are.';$('#start').textContent='RESUME  ↗';overlay.classList.remove('hidden')}else overlay.classList.add('hidden')}
function startButton(){if(paused){paused=false;overlay.classList.add('hidden');$('#status').textContent='IN PLAY'}else reset()}
function update(dt){if(!active||paused)return;platforms.forEach(p=>p.life-=dt);platforms=platforms.filter(p=>p.life>0);if(toastTimer>0&&(toastTimer-=dt)<=0)$('#toast').classList.remove('show');
// Piece gravity
fallTimer+=dt;const interval=Math.max(.12,.72-(level-1)*.055);while(fallTimer>=interval){fallTimer-=interval;if(!collides(piece,piece.x,piece.y+1))piece.y++;else{lock();break}}
// Player movement
let dir=(keys.right?1:0)-(keys.left?1:0);player.vx=dir*205;if(dir)player.face=dir;
let nx=player.x+player.vx*dt;nx=Math.max(BX,Math.min(BX+BW-20,nx));let box={x:nx,y:player.y,w:20,h:25};for(let r=0;r<ROWS;r++)for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++)if(board[r][c]&&overlap(box,{x:BX+c*C,y:BY+r*C,w:C,h:C})){if(dir>0)nx=BX+c*C-20;else if(dir<0)nx=BX+(c+1)*C}player.x=nx;
let oldY=player.y;player.vy+=1250*dt;player.y+=player.vy*dt;player.onGround=false;
// Land on solid blocks / floor / temporary one-way platforms
let floor=BY+BH;if(player.y+25>=floor&&oldY+25<=floor){player.y=floor-25;player.vy=0;player.onGround=true}
for(let r=0;r<ROWS;r++)for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++)if(board[r][c]){let top=BY+r*C;if(player.x+20>BX+c*C+2&&player.x<BX+(c+1)*C-2&&player.y+25>=top&&oldY+25<=top&&player.vy>=0){player.y=top-25;player.vy=0;player.onGround=true}}
for(const p of platforms)if(player.x+20>BX&&player.x<BX+BW&&player.y+25>=p.y&&oldY+25<=p.y&&player.vy>=0){player.y=p.y-25;player.vy=0;player.onGround=true}
// Block ceilings and side collisions keep the avatar inside the stack.
for(let r=0;r<ROWS;r++)for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++)if(board[r][c]&&overlap({x:player.x,y:player.y,w:20,h:25},{x:BX+c*C,y:BY+r*C,w:C,h:C})){if(player.vy<0){player.y=BY+(r+1)*C;player.vy=0}else if(player.onGround)player.y=BY+r*C-25}
if(player.y>H)player.y=H-25;
}
function overlap(a,b){return a.x<b.x+b.w&&a.x+a.w>b.x&&a.y<b.y+b.h&&a.y+a.h>b.y}

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a playable 2D Tetris-inspired platformer where cleared lines become temporary platforms the player can jump onto.

## Requirements
- User provided the concept: “2D Tetris where cleared lines become platforms you jump on”.
- No further requirements stated.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone responsive `index.html` game with canvas rendering, keyboard and touch controls, score/level tracking, and temporary platforms after line clears.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the game UI and core mechanics in `index.html`.
- Confirmed the extracted JavaScript passes `node --check`.
- Served the page locally and confirmed Chromium produced a screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/blockbound.png`.

### Active
- Review the screenshot and make any necessary gameplay or visual fixes.

### Blocked
- `playwright-cli open http://localhost:8765` could not launch because its expected Chromium browser was not installed; system Chromium worked for headless rendering.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `/tmp/opencode/blockbound.png` for visual issues.
2. Fix any issues, rerun syntax and browser checks, and report the completed implementation.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local Python HTTP server was started on port `8765` for verification.
